spots.name: Into the Rocky Blue
spots.type: Shore — rocky structure in main channel
spots.fish_class_notes: Best for active spinning on Slot 1 JigWinner + Casting Spoon 1/6 Oz #2. Cast into eddies behind rocks where bass and trophy crappie ambush in current breaks. The structure here is INACCESSIBLE TO the TeleValentine match rod — the JigWinner's casting reach is what pulled the Unique White Crappie 2.635 lb on 2026-06-10.

spots.name: Woody Enchantment
spots.type: Shore — log structure + slack water behind logs
spots.fish_class_notes: Best for the edge-sweep half of the dual-rod two-pass coverage tactic. TeleValentine match (#12 / 16" / pearl barley) along the edge here is the lap-1 producer. Then return with the JigWinner casting spoon for structured-zone pulls.

spots.name: Great Parking Job
spots.type: Shore — easy bank access, slack water near bank
spots.fish_class_notes: Lower-yield than Rocky Blue / Woody Enchantment but easiest access. Good for warm-up casts and rig dial-in.

spots.name: Rubble of Old Times
spots.fish_class_notes: Secondary structure spot. Casting spoon at structure perimeter (per [[feedback_marker_pattern_recognition]] edge-of-deep-zone pattern) is the likely trophy pull pattern here.

technique.retrieve_speed: Steady retrieve through panfish edge + structured zones; reel rate is the critical variable (sub-30" retrieve reels are the working window)
technique.rod_action: Light power Fast action; absorbs bass/shad bycatch without breaking the 4 Lb mono (line stresses to ~97% on the larger pulls but holds)
technique.key_principle: The Casting Spoon 1/6 Oz #2 is the lure size that admits panfish strikes AT Neherrin. Slop #4 catches bass but skips panfish entirely. The 27.5" retrieve gives panfish the inspection time to commit before the lure walks past.
technique.wait_time: Light/medium fish class — 15-30 sec target per [[feedback_competition_tactics]] stopwatch protocol

slots.notes: PRIMARY rig for both free fishing AND for the Neherrin minimal (spinning/casting-only) competition format. Targets edges, rocky structure, and weedy zones the TeleValentine match cannot reach. Pairs with Slot 2 (TeleValentine match) for the dual-rod two-pass coverage tactic in non-comp settings — see [[feedback_dual_rod_two_pass_coverage]]. The 4 Lb mono is the right tradeoff: 2 Lb would break on bass/shad bycatch; heavier line dampens panfish strike detection.

neherrin_minimal_competition_spinning_ca: VERIFY ROD-CLASS RULES BEFORE TRAVELING — do not bring a telescopic match (the 6/9 setup-fail mistake)
Run Slot 1 (JigWinner + Casting Spoon 1/6 Oz #2) as the SOLE comp rig
Target structured zones FIRST (Into the Rocky Blue, Rubble of Old Times) for trophy/unique pulls
Then sweep the edge for panfish count
Stopwatch the recasts at 30 sec per [[feedback_competition_tactics]] light/medium fish target
Spawn Sack alternate is legal if scoring is fish-count or weight (not lure-only)
free_fishing_dual_rod_two_pass_coverage: Lap 1: TeleValentine match (#12 / 16" / pearl barley) along the open river edge — 20-30 panfish per 20-min lap
Lap 2: JigWinner + Casting Spoon 1/6 Oz #2 at structured zones adjacent to the productive edge spots — +20-30 fish (panfish + bass + shad mix)
Pearl barley on lap 1 filters bass/shad bycatch (keeps the 2 Lb telescopic line safe); the 4 Lb mono on lap 2 accepts the bycatch by design
See [[feedback_dual_rod_two_pass_coverage]] for the full tactic memory

critical_warnings: ROD-CLASS VERIFICATION — Neherrin minimal comp is SPINNING/CASTING ONLY. The 2026-06-09 setup-fail wasted an hour of pre-scouting because user brought a telescopic match (banned). Read the comp tile rules BEFORE traveling.
2 LB LINE WILL BREAK on bass/shad bycatch when running the #2 casting spoon. The 4 Lb mono is the right tradeoff — stresses to ~97% on larger pulls but holds with careful play.
27.5" RETRIEVE WINDOW — sub-30" reels are empirically the working band for panfish commit on the #2 spoon at Neherrin. 31.5" tested same session = too fast.
REDEAR SUNFISH + GOLDEN SHINER DECLINED the #2 spoon on 2026-06-10. Don't expect these on the MVP rig — they need different bait coverage (Maggots / Bloodworms / smaller lure).
DRAGONCAST 7'3" NE IS NOT THE RIG HERE — the panfish density is too small for DragonCast's 5-10 lb bass/trout class to register fast strikes consistently. JigWinner's Light power is correct.

Slot 4 Loki preserved as predator/night backup.
